items.title: Alton Purnell Interview, 1958-08-29
items.q: most of the good piano players were working with bands like P. Rowan, Celestan, who used to get the best jobs.

ctx.x: What about the dance halls? Some of those real old time bands you know didn't even use the piano they say. Were there some of the dance halls like economy or hope solar cooperating? Did they all have pianos in them?

They had pianos in them but they had very few piano players you know that played with bands. They used to use banjo because I used to hear them and they used to before a band would go in the hall and play they used to play outside you know. And they used to use the banjos. And then whenever a band could get a good piano player why they would get it. But these jazz bands are you know, most of the good piano players were working with bands like P. Rowan, Celestan, who used to get the best jobs. And they were…
After you were seven years old they were supposed to be closed but they kept running the houses.
